summary: The nightly update now updates every part of the environment and leaves your own work alone.

fixes.title: Every part of the environment is updated
fixes.text: The nightly update finds every PIM Manager component that is deployed and updates them all. A component left behind fails the update.

fixes.title: Your own work is left alone
fixes.text: Anything else in the same resource group is left untouched, and skipped items are reported with the reason.
